title: Component kit: newer DOM features in a drawable element
blurb: A test element that draws a child in a canvas, written with a scoped registry, manual slot assignment, Reference Target, using, Observable and moveBefore(), and again without them. The page runs both and counts the lines.
question: Do a scoped custom element registry, manual slot assignment, Reference Target, using, Observable and moveBefore() work in a custom element whose shadow root draws its children in a canvas, and how much code does each remove?
result: All six work in Chromium 157. Five remove code, most of it for labels and slots; moveBefore() adds lines and fixes what script could not: a wrapped iframe no longer reloads.
